name: Hayase Aoi
source:
She’s in the same class as the protagonist and is his childhood friend.
She’s both talented and beautiful, has a friendly personality,
and is the most popular girl in school. She’s on the lacrosse team.
To the outside world, she's known as “a girl who’s hard to get even though she doesn’t have a specific boyfriend,” but, in reality, she’s dating a teacher at the school.
The protagonist’s parents and Aoi’s parents (from a distinguished, long-established family)
were simply on good terms due to “adult circumstances,” but Aoi still thinks of the protagonist as her childhood friend to this day.
She’s the type who, because she lacks assertiveness, tends to get dragged into messy situations.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120113190634if_/http://www.luchs.jp/psychs/reigaku/chara01.html]official site, archived[/url]]
